title: Counter tape patch
statement: Given a tape $c\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$, a starting position $p\in\mathbb{Z}$, and a finite word $w$ over $\Gamma$, define a new tape by placing the buffer encoding of $w$ at positions $p$ through $p+|w|-1$, with each position indexed relative to $p$, and leaving all other tape cells unchanged.
